title: Computation by compactly supported eventually periodic box transport
exact_target: For every machine and input and positive computable viscosity, do effective coefficients $f_0,f_1$ on $R^3$ yield $f=f_0+\nu $ $f_1$ and a zero-data smooth Navier–Stokes solution with pressure zero, both supported in one fixed compact spatial set and having globally bounded mixed derivatives, one-periodic after $t=1$, whose particle from (4,0,0) enters $(-1,2)^3$ exactly on halting? Require uniqueness in the stated C H2 intersect C1 L2 comparison class and, for a fixed machine, an input-independent repeated field.
